info.name: LifeSure gRPC (generated)
info.description: Best-effort, hand-authored collection for the LifeSure gRPC training project. Import this as a NEW collection (it already has a distinct name) rather than replacing anything. Addresses and message bodies are pre-filled and confirmed against the live servers; the exact JSON shape Postman uses internally for saved gRPC requests isn't publicly documented, so after import you will likely need to click "Select a method" once per request (reflection will populate it instantly since the servers register it) and re-check that the x-api-key metadata carried over as expected -- add it on the Metadata tab if it didn't. Import the sibling LifeSure.postman_environment.json first and select it as the active environment.

request.description: Unary. Service lifesure.quote.QuoteService, method GetQuote. Copy the response's quote_id and monthly_premium.minor_units into the quote_id/underwriting body below.

Unary. Service lifesure.policy.PolicyService, method CreatePolicy. Set monthly_premium.minor_units from the underwriting decision's adjusted_monthly_premium. Copy the response's policy_id into the policy_id environment variable.
Server-streaming. Service lifesure.policy.PolicyService, method ListPolicies. Click Invoke once; matching policies stream in one by one.
